digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and dispatch
propositions: a keyless-pending binding entry is not found by JQL search due to Jira DC Lucene index lag, causing recover_pending to unbind when the issue actually exists but is unindexed

when recover_pending unbinds a keyless-pending entry, the outbound_differ gates the create only on get_jira_key returning None, which is true for the now-deleted entry, causing dispatch_one.create_one to issue a duplicate create

the duplicate-preventing fix must gate the create at the write site (dispatch_one.create_one) rather than at plan time, and must consult both the absence of a key and the pendingness of a keyless binding within a grace window
recover_pending must corroborate absence by requiring both search_miss_count >= 3 and entry age exceeding a grace period before unbinding, leaving the entry pending until corroborated
a keyless-pending binding within the grace window must cause create_one to defer the create, not issue it, preserving the binding record so the gate has something to see on the next pass
